decisions.title: Event Search frontend runtime architecture
decisions.question: Which frontend runtime architecture should implement INV-EVS-001 while preserving backend-neutral Event Search behavior, CMDR-owned visual components, high security, high performance, accessibility, deep-link state, and minimal product-runtime supply-chain surface?
decisions.rationale: Event Search UI is a high-impact security/performance architecture choice. No frontend runtime has been accepted, and implementing UI first would create an implicit irreversible product-runtime dependency choice.
constraints: Product Spec remains read-only and CAP-INV-002 remains backend-neutral
CMDR visual components and product behavior remain first-party
INV-EVS-001 Loading Empty Partial Error Offline and Permission denied states must remain implementable
deep-link query scope filters and return context must survive refresh
keyboard accessibility and visible focus are mandatory
OPEN-013 remains unresolved and Case-link behavior is outside this decision
final query dialect index storage engine and search provider are outside this decision
